export type DaemonRouteMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE" | "ANY" | "WS";
export interface DaemonRoute {
    method: DaemonRouteMethod;
    path: string;
    feature?: DaemonFeature;
    summary: string;
}

export interface ClipEventData {
    runId: string;
    clip: string;
    at: string;
    seq: number;
    state?: string;
    position?: number;
    length?: number;
    gameMs?: number;
    heldMs?: number;
    frames?: number;
    holding?: string;
    mode?: string;
    region?: string | Record<string, unknown>;
    rate?: number;
    clipName?: string;
    check?: Record<string, unknown>;
    event?: Record<string, unknown>;
    takeId?: string;
    punchIn?: number;
    samples?: number;
    frame?: number;
    tracks?: Array<{
        action: string;
        type: string;
        notes: Array<{
            start: number;
            length: number;
            open?: boolean;
        }>;
        keys: Array<{
            t: number;
            v: number | number[];
        }>;
        keysFrom: number;
    }>;
    awaiting?: string[];
    stopReason?: string;
    passed?: boolean;
    summary?: Record<string, unknown>;
    drift?: Record<string, unknown>;
    resultsPath?: string;
}

export type ContextStrategy = "full" | "lean" | "micro";
export type ActionEffect = "read" | "mutate" | "unknown";
export type ActionEffectSource = "declared" | "inferred";
export interface ElicitParams {
    message: string;
    _meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
    requestedSchema: {
        type: "object";
        properties: Record<string, ElicitPrimitiveSchema>;
        required?: string[];
    };
}
export type ElicitPrimitiveSchema = {
    type: "string";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    enum?: string[];
    enumNames?: string[];
    default?: string;
} | {
    type: "number" | "integer";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    default?: number;
} | {
    type: "boolean";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    default?: boolean;
} | (ElicitMultiSelectBase & {
    items: {
        type: "string";
        enum: string[];
    };
}) | (ElicitMultiSelectBase & {
    items: {
        anyOf: Array<{
            const: string;
            title: string;
        }>;
    };
});
interface ElicitMultiSelectBase {
    type: "array";
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    minItems?: number;
    maxItems?: number;
    default?: string[];
}
export interface ElicitResult {
    action: "accept" | "decline" | "cancel";
    content?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[]>;
}
export interface ModelToolCall {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    arguments: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ModelMessage {
    role: "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";
    content: string;
    toolCalls?: ModelToolCall[];
    toolCallId?: string;
    name?: string;
}
export interface ModelToolDefinition {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    parameters: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface ModelRequest {
    system?: string;
    prompt?: string;
    messages?: ModelMessage[];
    model?: string;
    maxTokens?: number;
    temperature?: number;
    stop?: string[];
    schema?: Record<string, unknown>;
    tools?: ModelToolDefinition[];
    toolChoice?: "auto" | "none" | "required" | {
        name: string;
    };
    signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export interface ModelResponse {
    text: string;
    parsed?: unknown;
    toolCalls?: ModelToolCall[];
    finishReason?: "stop" | "tool_use" | "length" | (string & {});
    usage?: {
        inputTokens?: number;
        outputTokens?: number;
    };
    model?: string;
}
export interface ModelProvider {
    complete(req: ModelRequest): Promise<ModelResponse>;
}

export type CheckpointTrigger = "client" | "restore-before" | "restore-after";
export type ChangeStatus = "added" | "modified" | "deleted";
export type ChangeKind = "package" | "config" | "source" | "other";
export interface CheckpointInfo {
    id: string;

    createdAt: string;

    files: number;

    large?: true;

export interface AssetDiffRecord {
    displayString: string;
    diffType: string;
    category?: string;
    toolTip?: string;
    group?: string;
    hidden?: boolean;
    path?: string;
    label?: string;
    property?: string;
    before?: string | null;
    after?: string | null;
    graph?: string;

    node2?: AssetDiffNode;
    pin1?: {
        name: string;
        direction: string;
        nodeGuid?: string;
        defaultValue: string;
        linkedTo: string[];
    };
    pin2?: {
        name: string;
        direction: string;
        nodeGuid?: string;
        defaultValue: string;
        linkedTo: string[];
    };
    properties?: AssetDiffRecord[];
    facts?: AssetFact[];
    treeLocation?: number[];
    owningObjectPath?: string;
    propertyDiffType?: string;
}

        tool: string;

        format: string;

        available: boolean;
        reason?: string;
    };
}

    };

export declare const EXTENSION_PERMISSIONS: readonly ["registry.account"];
export type ExtensionPermission = (typeof EXTENSION_PERMISSIONS)[number];
export declare const REGISTRY_ACCOUNT_PERMISSION_REQUIRED_FROM = "1.4.20";
export interface ExtensionRequest {
    method: string;
    path: string;
    params: Record<string, string>;
    query: Record<string, string>;
    headers: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
    body: unknown;
}
export interface ExtensionResponse {
    status?: number;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    body?: unknown;
}
export type ExtensionHandler = (req: ExtensionRequest) => ExtensionResponse | undefined | Promise<ExtensionResponse | undefined>;
export interface CallActionOptions {
    dialogPrompt?: DialogPromptFn;
    dialogWaitMs?: number;
    elicit?: (params: ElicitParams) => Promise<ElicitResult>;
    access?: "read-write" | "read-only";
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    session?: {
        id: string;
        label?: string;
        parent?: string;
    };
}
export interface ContextCallOptions extends CallActionOptions {
    strategy?: ContextStrategy;
    categories?: string[];
}
export interface ActionResult {
    isError: boolean;
    content: Array<{
        type: string;
        text?: string;
    }>;
}
export interface ExtensionServicesApi {
    provide(id: string, impl: unknown): () => void;
    get<T>(id: string): T | undefined;
    watch<T>(id: string, cb: (impl: T | undefined) => void): () => void;
}
export interface DaemonExtensionApi {
    apiVersion: number;
    version: string;
    projectDir: string;
    dataDir: string;
    events: {
        publish(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): DaemonEvent;
        subscribe(listener: (e: DaemonEvent) => void): () => void;
        since(lastId: number): {
            events: DaemonEvent[];
            gap: boolean;
        };
    };
    route(method: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE", path: string, handler: ExtensionHandler): void;
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: CallActionOptions): Promise<ActionResult>;
    features?: readonly string[];
    nativeDialogs?: {
        list(): NativeDialogView[];
        press(hwnd: string, button: string, opts?: {
            pid?: number;
        }): Promise<NativeDialogPressResult>;
    };
    flows?: {
        approveSteps(approver: FlowStepApprover): () => void;
    };
    services?: ExtensionServicesApi;
    models?: {
        register(provider: ModelProvider): () => void;
    };
    checkpoints?: {
        state(opts?: {
            editor?: string;
            limit?: number;
        }): Promise<CheckpointState>;
        setEnabled(enabled: boolean | null, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<CheckpointState>;
        create(label?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<CheckpointResult>;
        changes(from: string, to?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
            assetDiffs?: boolean;
        }): Promise<ChangesResult>;
        assetDiff?(from: string, to: string | undefined, path: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<AssetDiff>;
        thumbnail?(id: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): {
            file: string;
            type: string;
        } | null;
        openNativeDiff?(path: string, from: string, to?: string, opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<NativeDiffResult>;
        restore(checkpoint: string, opts?: {
            paths?: string[];
            force?: boolean;
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<RestoreResult>;
        clear(opts?: {
            editor?: string;
        }): Promise<{
            editor: string;
            cleared: true;
        }>;
    };
    skills?: {
        list(): DaemonSkill[];
    };
    context?: {
        project(opts: ContextProjectionOptions): ContextProjection;
        call(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: ContextCallOptions): Promise<ActionResult>;
    };
    actions?: {
        effects(categories?: string[]): ActionEffectInfo[];
    };
    versions?(): {
        loaded: string;
        recorded: string | null;
        installed: string[];
    };
    editors(): EditorStatus[];
    editorOperation(op: "start" | "stop" | "restart" | "rebuild", opts?: EditorOperationOptions): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
    setBusy(busy: () => boolean): void;
    hub?: {
        configure(options: import("./hub-ports.js").HubClientOptions): () => void;
    };
    ui: {
        trustKey(pem: string): void;
        install(dir: string): UiManifest;
        active(): UiManifest | null;
        own?(): UiManifest | null;
    };
    registryAccount(): Promise<{
        login: string;
        token: string;
        registry: string;
    } | null>;
    modes?: {
        get(): {
            feedback: {
                mode: "interactive" | "auto-approve" | "defer";
                project: boolean;
            };
            dialog: {
                mode: "interactive" | "auto" | "defer" | null;
                project: boolean;
            };
            playtest: {
                mode: "manual" | "automatic" | null;
                project: boolean;
            };
        };
        setFeedback(mode: "interactive" | "auto-approve" | "defer" | undefined): void;
        setDialog(mode: "interactive" | "auto" | "defer" | undefined): void;
        setPlaytest(mode: "manual" | "automatic" | undefined): void;
    };
    log: {
        info(message: string): void;
        warn(message: string, detail?: unknown): void;
    };
}
export interface DaemonExtension {
    activate(api: DaemonExtensionApi): void | {
        dispose?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    } | Promise<void | {
        dispose?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    }>;
}

// ── contract/hub-qa.ts ──
import type { ArrangementRun } from "./hub-compose.js";
export type QaStepStatus = "pending" | "running" | "passed" | "failed" | "awaiting_verdict" | "skipped";
export type QaRunState = "draft" | "armed" | "running" | "awaiting_verdict" | "finished" | "stopped" | "idle";
export type QaVerdict = "pass" | "fail" | "skip";
export type QaVerdictSource = "auto" | "action" | "elicitation" | "agent" | "source_run";
export interface QaExpect {
    value: string;
    op: string;
    target?: number | boolean;
    within_ms?: number;
}
export interface QaEvidence {
    value?: string;
    at_start?: number | null;
    at_end?: number | null;
    samples?: number;
    observed?: boolean;
    verdict_frame?: number;
    verdict_at_ms?: number;
    reason?: string;
    note?: string;
    captures?: string[];
}
export interface QaStep {
    index: number;
    instruction: string;
    judge: "auto" | "manual";
    expect?: QaExpect;
    status: QaStepStatus;
    withinMs?: number;
    startedAtMs?: number;
    endedAtMs?: number;
    evidence?: QaEvidence;
    note?: string;
    verdictSource?: QaVerdictSource;
    agentJudgeable?: boolean;
    player?: string;
    sourceStatus?: QaStepStatus;
    regression?: boolean;
    arrange?: unknown;
    act?: unknown;
    actResult?: QaActResult;
}
export interface QaActResult {

export declare const HUB_ROUTES: {
    readonly overview: "GET /hub";
    readonly goal: "GET /hub/goals/:id -> GoalState";
    readonly createGoal: "POST /hub/goals GoalDraft -> { goal: Goal }";
    readonly updateGoal: "PUT /hub/goals/:id GoalUpdate -> { goal: Goal }";
    readonly deleteGoal: "DELETE /hub/goals/:id -> 204";
    readonly addChecks: "POST /hub/goals/:id/checks { checks: CheckRef[] } -> { goal }";
    readonly removeCheck: "DELETE /hub/goals/:id/checks/:checkId -> { goal }";
    readonly updateGoalCheck: "PUT /hub/goals/:id/checks/:checkId GoalCheckUpdate -> { goal }";
    readonly orderChecks: "PUT /hub/goals/:id/checks/order { order: checkIds } -> { goal }";
    readonly addRequire: "POST /hub/goals/:id/requires { goal, required? } -> { goal } (an existing entry takes the new required)";
    readonly removeRequire: "DELETE /hub/goals/:id/requires/:goalId -> { goal }";
    readonly orderRequires: "PUT /hub/goals/:id/requires { order: goalIds } -> { goal }";
    readonly signOff: "POST /hub/goals/:id/sign-off { note? } -> { signOff: SignOff } (409 without a signed-in account)";
    readonly clearSignOff: "DELETE /hub/goals/:id/sign-off -> 204";
    readonly writePlaytests: "POST /hub/goals/:id/write-playtests { text? } -> 202 { sessionId }";
    readonly check: "GET /hub/checks/:checkId?limit=&before= -> CheckDetail";
    readonly updateCheck: "PUT /hub/checks/:checkId CheckMetaUpdate -> { meta: CheckMeta }";
    readonly rules: "PUT /hub/rules Partial<HealthRule> -> { rules: HealthRule }";
    readonly exportStore: "GET /hub/store -> HubExport";
    readonly importStore: "POST /hub/store HubExport -> HubImportReport (merge by id; 400 naming every record that does not read)";
    readonly runs: "GET /hub/runs?check=&limit=&before= -> { runs: RunRecord[], more: boolean }";
    readonly run: "GET /hub/runs/:runId -> RunDetail";
    readonly addRunLink: "POST /hub/runs/:runId/links { link: TrackerLink } -> { record: RunRecord }";
    readonly removeRunLink: "DELETE /hub/runs/:runId/links?url= -> { record: RunRecord }";
    readonly queue: "GET /hub/queue -> QueueState";
    readonly plan: "POST /hub/plans PlanRequest -> { plan: PlanRun, placement: PlanPlacement } (a person's Run resumes a paused queue)";
    readonly cancelPlan: "POST /hub/plans/:id/cancel -> { plan }";
    readonly movePlan: "POST /hub/plans/:id/move { to: number } -> QueueState (0 is next)";
    readonly createSchedule: "POST /hub/schedules ScheduleDraft -> { schedule }";
    readonly updateSchedule: "PUT /hub/schedules/:id Partial<ScheduleDraft> -> { schedule }";
    readonly deleteSchedule: "DELETE /hub/schedules/:id -> 204";
    readonly pause: "PUT /hub/queue/paused { paused: boolean } -> QueueState";
    readonly lease: "GET /hub/lease -> HubLeaseEvent";
    readonly release: "POST /hub/release -> QueueState (stops what the hub holds on the editor and pauses the queue)";
    readonly fix: "POST /hub/fix FixRequest -> { queued: number, plan: PlanRun | null, placement?: PlanPlacement } (a fix plan: one chat session per check)";
    readonly runCheck: "POST /hub/checks/:checkId/run { replay?, next? } -> { plan: PlanRun, placement: PlanPlacement }";
    readonly arrangement: "GET /hub/goals/:id/arrangement -> ArrangementView";
    readonly putArrangement: "PUT /hub/goals/:id/arrangement { arrangement } | { text } -> ArrangementView (400 { error, findings })";
    readonly editArrangement: "POST /hub/goals/:id/arrangement/edit { ops } -> ArrangementView & { changed } (400 { error, finding, findings })";
    readonly set: "GET /hub/set -> SetView";
    readonly editSet: "POST /hub/set/edit { ops } -> SetView & { changed } (400 { error, finding })";
    readonly clips: "GET /hub/clips?q=&kind= -> { clips: ClipEntry[] }";
    readonly runSet: "POST /hub/run { scope: track | scene | slot | arrangement, next? } -> { plan: PlanRun, placement: PlanPlacement, runId: string | null } (runId once a plan that started at once has its run)";
    readonly runVerdict: "POST /hub/runs/:runId/verdict { check, verdict, note? } -> { ok: true } (a manual check in a track or scene run)";
};
export interface ArrangementView {
    arrangement: Arrangement;
    text: string;
    layout: InstanceLayout[];
    findings: ArrangementFinding[];
}
export interface SetView {
    tracks: Array<{
        id: string;
        title: string;
        order: number;
        color?: SetColor;
        player: number;
        mute: boolean;
        solo: boolean;
        arrangement: Arrangement;
        layout: InstanceLayout[];
        status: GoalStatus;
    }>;
    scenes: Array<{
        id: string;
        title: string;
        order: number;
        color?: SetColor;
        tracks: string[];
        slots: Array<Slot & {
            length: number | null;
        }>;
        status: GoalStatus;
    }>;
    text: string;
    findings: ArrangementFinding[];
}
export interface ClipEntry {
    kind: "clip" | "script";
    target: string;
    name: string;
    map: string | null;
    length: number | null;
    rate: number;
    lastRun: {
        runId: string;
        outcome: string;
        at: string;
    } | null;
}
export type PlaytestRunsMode = "manual" | "automatic";
export interface BusyCall {
    id: number;
    category: string;
    action: string;
    startedAt: number;
    source: "agent" | "client";
    sessionId?: string;
    client?: string;
    stopped: boolean;
}
export interface EditorOperation {
    op: "start" | "stop" | "restart" | "rebuild";
    step: string;
    startedAt: number;
    stepStartedAt: number;
}
export interface EditorOperationFailure {
    op: EditorOperation["op"];
    step: string;
    reason: string;
    at: number;
}
export interface BusyState {
    now: number;
    calls: BusyCall[];
    operation?: EditorOperation;
    failure?: EditorOperationFailure;
}
export {};

// ── contract/hub-attention.ts ──
import { type AttentionItem, type CheckState, type GoalState, type PlanRun } from "./hub.js";
import { type QaRun } from "./hub-qa.js";
export declare const PLAN_FAILED_DAYS = 3;
export interface AttentionInput {
    runs: QaRun[];
    goals: GoalState[];
    checks: CheckState[];
    plans: PlanRun[];
    now: number;
}
export declare function buildAttention(i: AttentionInput): AttentionItem[];

// ── contract/hub-ports.ts ──
import type { ActionResult } from "./daemon.js";
import type { BusyCall, PlanItem, PlanRun, PlaytestRunsMode } from "./hub.js";
import type { QaRun } from "./hub-qa.js";
export interface HubHost {
    projectDir: string;
    dataDir: string;
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ActionResult>;
    editors(): Array<{
        connected: boolean;
    }>;
    events: {
        publish(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): unknown;
        subscribe(listener: (e: {
            type: string;
            data: Record<string, unknown>;
        }) => void): () => void;
    };
    log: {
        warn(message: string, detail?: unknown): void;
    };
}
export interface ListedScript {
    path: string;
    name: string;
    map?: string;
}
export interface RunTimes {
    startedAt?: string;
    endedAt?: string;
}
export interface HubScriptIndex {
    listScripts(fresh?: boolean): Promise<ListedScript[]>;
    recorded(limit: number): Promise<Array<{
        run: QaRun;
        times: RunTimes;
    }>>;
}
export interface HubBroker {
    all(): QaRun[];
    get(runId: string): QaRun | undefined;
    onSaved(listener: (run: QaRun, replaces?: string) => void): () => void;
    status(runId: string): Promise<{
        answer: Record<string, unknown>;
        run: QaRun | null;
    } | {
        error: string;
    }>;
    readScriptAt(script: string): Promise<{
        run: QaRun;
    } | {
        error: string;
        status?: number;
    }>;
    startScript(script: string, start: {
        planRunId: string;
        title: string;
    }): Promise<{
        run: QaRun;
    } | {
        error: string;
    }>;
    stopRun(runId: string, reason: string): Promise<{
        run: QaRun;
    } | {
        error: string;
        status?: number;
    }>;
    setPlanWait?(wait: (run: QaRun) => number | undefined): void;
}
export interface HubFixer {
    start(item: PlanItem, plan: PlanRun): Promise<{
        runId: string;
        sessionId?: string;
    } | {
        error: string;
    }>;
    stop(item: PlanItem): string | null;
    running(): Set<string>;
    holds?(run: QaRun): boolean;
}
export interface VerdictHoldOptions {
    owns?(run: QaRun): boolean;
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ActionResult>;
    publish(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): unknown;
    log: {
        warn(message: string, detail?: unknown): void;
    };
    stop(runId: string, reason: string): Promise<unknown>;
    waitMinutes(run: QaRun): number;
    now?: () => number;
}
export interface CallingHost<O = unknown> {
    callAction(category: string, action: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>, opts?: O): Promise<ActionResult>;
}
export type HubWritePlaytests = (request: {
    title: string;
    text: string;
}) => {
    sessionId: string;
    done: Promise<void>;
};
export interface HubPolicy {
    signer?: () => string | null | Promise<string | null>;
    playtestRuns?: () => PlaytestRunsMode;
    enabled?: () => boolean;
}
export interface HubClientOptions extends HubPolicy {
    broker?: HubBroker;
    fixer?: HubFixer;
    writePlaytests?: HubWritePlaytests;
    replay?: (script: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<ActionResult>;
    inputAgeMs?: () => number | null;
    agentCalls?: () => BusyCall[];
}
